Hi @eng-56! I'm working on ROUTEKIT-113 (find_cycle). The ticket mentions you have the notes from the design review regarding edge-case decisions for this function. Could you share them with me?

The design review notes I have say: A line of None marks a hand-carried leg inside a hub (no truck involved). Such legs are not a line and are skipped when comparing lines: L1 -> None -> L2 is one transfer, and L1 -> None -> L1 is no transfer at all.
